name: genetics_terms
description: Complete definitions of genetic and molecular-biology concepts; matched controls explicitly give the term.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('The molecule that stores hereditary information in most organisms is','DNA'),('A segment of DNA encoding a functional product is a','gene'),('Different versions of the same gene are called','alleles'),('An organism\'s complete set of genetic material is its','genome'),('An organism\'s genetic constitution is its','genotype'),('An organism\'s observable characteristics constitute its','phenotype'),('A change in a DNA sequence is called a','mutation'),('The process of copying DNA into RNA is called','transcription'),('The process of decoding messenger RNA into protein is called','translation'),('The process of duplicating DNA is called','replication'),('The sugar in RNA is','ribose'),('The base found in RNA in place of thymine is','uracil'),('In DNA, adenine pairs with','thymine'),('In DNA, guanine pairs with','cytosine'),('The enzyme that joins DNA fragments is called DNA','ligase'),('The enzyme that unwinds the DNA double helix is','helicase'),('The structures composed of DNA and proteins that carry genes are','chromosomes'),('The cell division that produces gametes is','meiosis'),('The cell division producing two genetically identical nuclei is','mitosis'),('Proteins around which DNA is wrapped in chromatin are','histones')]
items=[];control=[]
for prefix in ['Genetics: ','Complete the biology definition: ','Molecular biology review. ','In genetics: ']:
 for d,a in pairs:
  p=prefix+d;items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+a});control.append({'prompt':'Reference term: '+a+'. Copy the reference term. '+p,'answer':' '+a})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
